nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Excludes node_modules, dist, git metadata, IDE files, and markdown/docs from the Docker build context so root-context image builds stay fast and don't leak source-control or documentation artifacts.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Orchestrates the full application stack — nginx-served React frontend, FastAPI backend, Celery worker, PaddleOCR microservice, Redis, and a pgvector-enabled Postgres database — wiring build contexts, healthchecks, volumes, and startup ordering via depends_on conditions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses depends_on with service_healthy/service_started conditions to sequence startup across six interdependent containers rather than relying on fixed sleep delays.

nodes.name: frontend
nodes.summary: Builds and runs the React/Vite frontend from the root Dockerfile, mapping host port 3000 to nginx's port 80, and waits for the backend to report healthy before starting.

nodes.name: backend
nodes.summary: Builds and runs the FastAPI backend from backend/Dockerfile on port 8000, mounts uploads/logs volumes, loads secrets from .env, and gates startup on the database, Redis, and worker being healthy or started.

nodes.name: worker
nodes.summary: Runs the Celery worker (celery -A app.workers.celery_app.celery_app worker) built from the backend image, sharing the uploads/logs volumes and waiting on the database, Redis, and OCR service to be healthy.

nodes.name: ocr
nodes.summary: Builds and runs the PaddleOCR microservice from ocr-service/Dockerfile, exposing port 8080 internally with a health check that the worker's startup gate depends on.

nodes.name: redis
nodes.summary: Runs the official redis:7-alpine image used as the Celery broker/result backend, with a redis-cli ping healthcheck gating dependent services.

nodes.name: db
nodes.summary: Runs the pgvector/pgvector:pg16 Postgres image as the primary datastore for the chatbot database, with a persistent named volume, seeded credentials, a pg_isready healthcheck, and host port 5434 exposed for local access.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the Vite/React frontend (npm ci + npm run build) in a node:22-alpine stage, then serves the resulting static bundle from an nginx:alpine runtime image with a wget-based health check on port 80.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage build discards the Node.js toolchain in the final image, shipping only the compiled static assets behind nginx to keep the runtime image minimal.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: First build stage (node:22-alpine) that installs npm dependencies via npm ci and runs the production Vite build, producing the /app/dist output consumed by the runner stage.

nodes.name: runner
nodes.summary: Final runtime stage (nginx:alpine) that copies the built frontend assets and nginx.conf into place, exposes port 80, and defines a container healthcheck against the served site.
